verdict.rationale: The CRA delivers its services through software (Business Registration Online, the e-services portals, EFILE), and government digital services can plausibly publish their code under an open license, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions published source code, a public repository, or an open license for any CRA system. The pack covers only registration, e-services, EFILE functionality and an llms.txt probe, so absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.
